prompt: What were average daily steps during the intern year (July 2025 to June 2026) for the 2025 cohort's Garmin users? Exploratory is fine: no plan needed.
tests: superseded duplicate rows in GARMINDAILYSUMMARY; n and uncertainty

checks.name: one row per participant-day
checks.detail: expected ~7465 (all) or ~7443 (enrolled) keeping the latest row per day; ~7286 means superseded rows were averaged in

checks.name: uncertainty given
checks.detail: a CI or SE: with ~25 people it's wide

answer:
Bottom line, exploratory: for the 2025 cohort’s Garmin users, average daily steps during July 2025-June 2026 were **7,465 steps per observed participant-day**. Giving each Garmin user equal weight instead, the mean of participant-specific daily averages was **7,381 steps/day** with a **95% CI of 6,889 to 7,872**.

I used `IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY`, `CALENDARDATE`, and `STEPS`. The window contained **28 participants**, **8,584 raw Garmin daily-summary rows**, and **8,024 unique participant-days** after deduplicating to one row per participant-day. Coverage was **78.5%** of the 28 x 365 possible participant-days; the median participant contributed **293.5 observed days**.

Key data check: **552 participant-days had duplicate Garmin summary rows**, and 475 of those had differing step values. The primary estimate used the **latest inserted row per participant-day**. Sensitivity was close: averaging duplicates gave **7,363 steps/day**, while using all rows without deduplication gave **7,286 steps/day**.

Deliverables:
- Report: `/work/outputs/garmin_steps_2025_report.html`
- Monthly summary CSV: `/work/outputs/garmin_steps_2025_monthly_summary.csv`
- Sensitivity CSV: `/work/outputs/garmin_steps_2025_sensitivity_summary.csv`
- Complete SQL provenance: `/work/outputs/garmin_steps_2025_sql_provenance.md`
- Reproducible source: `/work/garmin_steps_2025_analysis.R`

Main limitation: this describes observed Garmin data only, not all 2025 interns or all days. I did not verify wear time/device adherence beyond the daily summary records, so missing device use could still affect the averages.
queries:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS rows_in_window,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants_in_window,
  MIN(calendardate) AS min_calendar_date,
  MAX(calendardate) AS max_calendar_date,
  SUM(CASE WHEN participantidentifier IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_participantidentifier,
  SUM(CASE WHEN calendardate IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_calendardate,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_missing_steps,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps < 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_negative_steps,
  SUM(CASE WHEN steps > 100000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rows_steps_gt_100k
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH day_counts AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, COUNT(*) AS records_per_person_day
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS participant_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
  SUM(CASE WHEN records_per_person_day > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicated_person_days,
  MAX(records_per_person_day) AS max_records_per_person_day
FROM day_counts

WITH day_stats AS (
  SELECT
    participantidentifier,
    calendardate,
    COUNT(*) AS n_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT summaryid) AS n_summaryids,
    COUNT(DISTINCT steps) AS n_step_values,
    MIN(steps) AS min_steps,
    MAX(steps) AS max_steps
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_record_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_record_days,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 AND n_step_values = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_days_same_steps,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n_rows > 1 AND n_step_values > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS duplicate_days_different_steps,
  MAX(n_rows) AS max_rows_per_day,
  MAX(max_steps - min_steps) AS max_step_spread_within_duplicate_day
FROM day_stats

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS distinct_participantidentifiers,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantid) AS distinct_participantids,
  COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier || '|' || participantid) AS distinct_identifier_id_pairs
FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')

WITH day_counts AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, COUNT(*) AS records_per_person_day
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
)
SELECT records_per_person_day, COUNT(*) AS participant_days
FROM day_counts
GROUP BY records_per_person_day
ORDER BY records_per_person_day

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    participantidentifier,
    calendardate,
    steps,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
      ORDER BY inserteddate DESC NULLS LAST, summaryid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND participantidentifier IS NOT NULL
    AND calendardate IS NOT NULL
    AND steps IS NOT NULL
    AND steps >= 0
    AND steps <= 100000
), daily_latest AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
), participant_means AS (
  SELECT
    participantidentifier,
    COUNT(*) AS observed_days,
    AVG(steps) AS mean_daily_steps
  FROM daily_latest
  GROUP BY participantidentifier
), monthly AS (
  SELECT
    TRUNC(calendardate, 'MM') AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS participant_days,
    COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
    AVG(steps) AS mean_daily_steps,
    MEDIAN(steps) AS median_daily_steps
  FROM daily_latest
  GROUP BY TRUNC(calendardate, 'MM')
)
SELECT 'overall_participant_day_weighted' AS summary_type,
       CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS month_start,
       COUNT(*) AS participant_days,
       COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
       AVG(steps) AS mean_daily_steps,
       MEDIAN(steps) AS median_daily_steps,
       STDDEV(steps) AS sd_daily_steps,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS median_observed_days_per_participant,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS q1_observed_days_per_participant,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS q3_observed_days_per_participant,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS participant_weighted_mean_of_means,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS sd_participant_means
FROM daily_latest
UNION ALL
SELECT 'overall_participant_weighted' AS summary_type,
       CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS month_start,
       SUM(observed_days) AS participant_days,
       COUNT(*) AS participants,
       AVG(mean_daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps,
       MEDIAN(mean_daily_steps) AS median_daily_steps,
       STDDEV(mean_daily_steps) AS sd_daily_steps,
       MEDIAN(observed_days) AS median_observed_days_per_participant,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.25) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY observed_days) AS q1_observed_days_per_participant,
       PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY observed_days) AS q3_observed_days_per_participant,
       AVG(mean_daily_steps) AS participant_weighted_mean_of_means,
       STDDEV(mean_daily_steps) AS sd_participant_means
FROM participant_means
UNION ALL
SELECT 'monthly_participant_day_weighted' AS summary_type,
       month_start,
       participant_days,
       participants,
       mean_daily_steps,
       median_daily_steps,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS sd_daily_steps,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS median_observed_days_per_participant,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS q1_observed_days_per_participant,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS q3_observed_days_per_participant,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS participant_weighted_mean_of_means,
       CAST(NULL AS NUMBER) AS sd_participant_means
FROM monthly
ORDER BY summary_type, month_start

WITH base AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps, inserteddate, summaryid
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND participantidentifier IS NOT NULL
    AND calendardate IS NOT NULL
    AND steps IS NOT NULL
    AND steps >= 0
    AND steps <= 100000
), latest_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    participantidentifier, calendardate, steps,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
      ORDER BY inserteddate DESC NULLS LAST, summaryid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
), latest_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps AS daily_steps
  FROM latest_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
), mean_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, AVG(steps) AS daily_steps
  FROM base
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
), max_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, MAX(steps) AS daily_steps
  FROM base
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
), all_rows_pm AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(steps) AS mean_daily_steps
  FROM base
  GROUP BY participantidentifier
), latest_pm AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps
  FROM latest_day
  GROUP BY participantidentifier
), mean_pm AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps
  FROM mean_day
  GROUP BY participantidentifier
), max_pm AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps
  FROM max_day
  GROUP BY participantidentifier
)
SELECT 'all_rows_no_deduplication' AS method,
       COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
       AVG(steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean,
       (SELECT AVG(mean_daily_steps) FROM all_rows_pm) AS participant_weighted_mean
FROM base
UNION ALL
SELECT 'latest_inserted_per_person_day' AS method,
       COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
       AVG(daily_steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean,
       (SELECT AVG(mean_daily_steps) FROM latest_pm) AS participant_weighted_mean
FROM latest_day
UNION ALL
SELECT 'mean_within_duplicate_person_day' AS method,
       COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
       AVG(daily_steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean,
       (SELECT AVG(mean_daily_steps) FROM mean_pm) AS participant_weighted_mean
FROM mean_day
UNION ALL
SELECT 'max_within_duplicate_person_day' AS method,
       COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
       COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
       AVG(daily_steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean,
       (SELECT AVG(mean_daily_steps) FROM max_pm) AS participant_weighted_mean
FROM max_day
ORDER BY method

WITH base AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps, inserteddate, summaryid
  FROM IHS_2025.GARMINDAILYSUMMARY
  WHERE calendardate >= TO_DATE(:start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND calendardate < TO_DATE(:end_exclusive, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
    AND participantidentifier IS NOT NULL
    AND calendardate IS NOT NULL
    AND steps IS NOT NULL
    AND steps >= 0
    AND steps <= 100000
), latest_ranked AS (
  SELECT
    participantidentifier, calendardate, steps,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY participantidentifier, calendardate
      ORDER BY inserteddate DESC NULLS LAST, summaryid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
), latest_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, steps AS daily_steps
  FROM latest_ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
), mean_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, AVG(steps) AS daily_steps
  FROM base
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
), max_day AS (
  SELECT participantidentifier, calendardate, MAX(steps) AS daily_steps
  FROM base
  GROUP BY participantidentifier, calendardate
), all_rows_summary AS (
  SELECT 'all_rows_no_deduplication' AS method,
         COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
         COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
         AVG(steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean
  FROM base
), all_rows_person AS (
  SELECT 'all_rows_no_deduplication' AS method,
         AVG(mean_daily_steps) AS participant_weighted_mean
  FROM (
    SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(steps) AS mean_daily_steps
    FROM base
    GROUP BY participantidentifier
  )
), latest_summary AS (
  SELECT 'latest_inserted_per_person_day' AS method,
         COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
         COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
         AVG(daily_steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean
  FROM latest_day
), latest_person AS (
  SELECT 'latest_inserted_per_person_day' AS method,
         AVG(mean_daily_steps) AS participant_weighted_mean
  FROM (
    SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps
    FROM latest_day
    GROUP BY participantidentifier
  )
), mean_summary AS (
  SELECT 'mean_within_duplicate_person_day' AS method,
         COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
         COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
         AVG(daily_steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean
  FROM mean_day
), mean_person AS (
  SELECT 'mean_within_duplicate_person_day' AS method,
         AVG(mean_daily_steps) AS participant_weighted_mean
  FROM (
    SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps
    FROM mean_day
    GROUP BY participantidentifier
  )
), max_summary AS (
  SELECT 'max_within_duplicate_person_day' AS method,
         COUNT(*) AS analytic_records,
         COUNT(DISTINCT participantidentifier) AS participants,
         AVG(daily_steps) AS participant_day_weighted_mean
  FROM max_day
), max_person AS (
  SELECT 'max_within_duplicate_person_day' AS method,
         AVG(mean_daily_steps) AS participant_weighted_mean
  FROM (
    SELECT participantidentifier, AVG(daily_steps) AS mean_daily_steps
    FROM max_day
    GROUP BY participantidentifier
  )
)
SELECT s.method, s.analytic_records, s.participants,
       s.participant_day_weighted_mean, p.participant_weighted_mean
FROM all_rows_summary s JOIN all_rows_person p ON s.method = p.method
UNION ALL
SELECT s.method, s.analytic_records, s.participants,
       s.participant_day_weighted_mean, p.participant_weighted_mean
FROM latest_summary s JOIN latest_person p ON s.method = p.method
UNION ALL
SELECT s.method, s.analytic_records, s.participants,
       s.participant_day_weighted_mean, p.participant_weighted_mean
FROM mean_summary s JOIN mean_person p ON s.method = p.method
UNION ALL
SELECT s.method, s.analytic_records, s.participants,
       s.participant_day_weighted_mean, p.participant_weighted_mean
FROM max_summary s JOIN max_person p ON s.method = p.method
ORDER BY method
